Since you're targeting Product-Based companies

Trust me—your database knowledge must be strong in query optimization, indexing, transactions, locking mechanisms, partitioning, and database system design.

➊ 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐅𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐬 & 𝐀𝐫𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞
Understand how databases work, their components, and architecture.

 ↳ Database types (Relational, NoSQL)
 ↳ ACID properties & CAP theorem
 ↳ DBMS vs. RDBMS vs. NoSQL
 ↳ Database Storage Engines (InnoDB vs. MyISAM)
 ↳ Database Architecture (Single-tier, Two-tier, Three-tier)

➋ 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐠 & 𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐎𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
Improve query performance with indexing & optimization techniques.

 ↳ Types of Indexes (Clustered, Non-clustered, Composite, Unique, Full-text, Bitmap)
 ↳ How Indexing Works (B-Trees, Hash Indexing, etc.)
 ↳ Indexing Best Practices & When NOT to Use Indexes
 ↳ Query Execution Plan (EXPLAIN ANALYZE)
 ↳ Optimizing Joins, Sorting, and Aggregations

➌ 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 & 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐲 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥
Ensure consistency and integrity in multi-user database environments.

 ↳ ACID properties in transactions
 ↳ Transaction isolation levels (READ COMMITTED, REPEATABLE READ, SERIALIZABLE)
 ↳ Locking mechanisms (Pessimistic vs. Optimistic)
 ↳ Deadlocks – Causes & Prevention
 ↳ Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC)

➍ 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 & 𝐒𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠
Scale databases by distributing data efficiently.

 ↳ Horizontal vs. Vertical Partitioning
 ↳ Range, List, Hash, and Composite Partitioning
 ↳ Sharding Strategies (Key-based, Range-based, Directory-based)
 ↳ Challenges in Sharding (Data consistency, Cross-shard queries)
 ↳ Replication vs. Sharding

➎ 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚 𝐌𝐨𝐝𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠 & 𝐍𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
Design efficient, scalable database schemas.

 ↳ Entity-Relationship (ER) Modeling
 ↳ Normal Forms (1NF to 5NF)
 ↳ Denormalization & When to Use It
 ↳ Star vs. Snowflake Schema (Data Warehousing)
 ↳ Handling One-to-Many & Many-to-Many Relationships

➏ 𝐒𝐐𝐋 𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐓𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠
Optimize SQL queries for high performance.

 ↳ Writing Efficient SQL Queries
 ↳ Avoiding Full Table Scans
 ↳ Use of Proper Indexing Strategies
 ↳ Query Execution Plans & Optimization Techniques
 ↳ Materialized Views & Caching

➐ 𝐍𝐨𝐒𝐐𝐋 𝐯𝐬. 𝐒𝐐𝐋 – 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐔𝐬𝐞 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭?
Choosing the right database for the right use case.

 ↳ SQL vs. NoSQL (Key differences)
 ↳ Types of NoSQL Databases (Document, Key-Value, Columnar, Graph)
 ↳ When to Use NoSQL Over SQL
 ↳ CAP Theorem & BASE Properties in NoSQL
 ↳ Examples: MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB

Join me: https://lnkd.in/giE3e9yH
